name: Tag Duels
author: deepdream and Codex
description: Two-versus-two Free Duels with separate decks and hands, shared team Life Points and field, rotating teammates and team-based ranking. Choose a signature, edited or recipe partner deck; let CPU, Player 1 or Player 2 control the partner. Tag Rewards is a default-on setting that mixes both rivals' drop pools and reserves the final drop for rare spoils. Requires Duel Options.

settings.label: Tag Rewards
settings.description: Roll rewards from both opponents and reserve the last configured drop for a rare card. Disable to use the native reward policy; inventory safety remains active.
